sectorImpacts.reason: Rising crude oil prices due to supply fears are generally positive for upstream oil and gas companies.
Higher crude oil prices directly increase fuel costs, negatively impacting airline profitability.
Increased fuel costs can dampen consumer demand for vehicles, especially those with lower fuel efficiency.
Many chemical companies use crude oil derivatives as raw materials, leading to higher input costs.
Inflationary pressures and rising bond yields could lead to tighter monetary policy, impacting credit growth and asset quality.
